profile.headline: Senior Engineer @ Postman AI Team
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of engineers in the 0-to-1, end-to-end development of CyberConvoy’s flagship product, C.O.R.E, a full-stack web application empowering cybersecurity analysts, detection engineers, data scientists, and medium-to-large-scale organizations — including healthcare providers, financial services, real estate firms, and manufacturing companies — to proactively detect and respond to cybersecurity threats
• Architected and implemented a robust SIEM engine, integrating advanced data collection, analysis, and correlation techniques to process over 5 billion daily security events from approximately 55,000 end users, enabling real-time threat detection and incident response
• Designed and implemented AI-powered systems to augment cybersecurity operations, including multi-agent workflows using LangGraph and LangChain to autonomously triage and escalate threats, internal MCP servers for real-time data access, a Vercel AI SDK–based chatbot enabling natural language queries across organizational infrastructure, and a robust evals framework to A/B test and optimize model performance in production
• Built a suite of proprietary, secure software solutions for automation and integration, streamlining complex cybersecurity workflows and enhancing productivity across the organization
• Played a pivotal role in scaling CyberConvoy’s development team by interviewing and technically assessing hundreds of candidates, hiring top talent, and mentoring newly onboarded engineers to uphold a high standard of code quality and innovation
• Spearheaded the design and deployment of CI/CD pipelines and containerized microservices, reducing deployment times and increasing system reliability and scalability in production environments

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of engineers in the design and development of Docketeer, utilizing the latest technologies such as React, RTK, Tailwind, cAdvisor, Prometheus, Grafana, NodeExporter, and Docker
• Modularized application to microservice architecture through constructing multi-architecture docker images that comprise the entire application and required dependencies to achieve deployment, development, and management optimizations
• Transformed existing client-side code (integration of RTK, custom-hooks, and other abstractions) to eliminate signiﬁcant technical debt by adhering to MVC design pattern ultimately bolstering longevity by increasing the maintainability of the software
• Reconstructed entire UI/UX utilizing TailwindCSS to provide the ﬁrst major design change since the inception of Docketeer
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · CLI · React.js · Software Testing · Test Driven Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · Grafana · Docker Products · Tailwind CSS · Express.js · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Agile Methodologies · Jest · Git · TypeScript · Document Object Model (DOM) · Node.js · Prometheus.io · JSON Web Token (JWT) · cAdvisor · Redux.js · JavaScript · Electron · Webpack · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Clinical Researcher
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Contributed in transition to RedCap for research data organization/monitoring
• Contributed to innovative clinical research involving identiﬁcation of novel biomarkers in squamous cell carcinoma to eliminate elective neck dissections in patients
• Constructed annual IND report for pharmaceutical company & FDA on phase 2, single-center, single-arm, open-label trial of vismodegib in patients with keratocystic odontogenic tumors

projects.title: photogenicus
projects.description:
• Built photogenicus through integration of TensorFlow ML/AI models & shards, reﬁned with reference data, and queried with web-captured images to enable facial identiﬁcation/recognition in a React/Node application
• Queried SQL database for blob-type media to parse into tensor-type media for initial reﬁnement of model and/or future auth queries
• Practiced memory leak debugging ensuring adequate disposal of created tensors in avoidance of end-user memory leaks

projects.title: storybook
projects.description:
• Built 3D-rendered AI-generated storybook application utilizing React/RTK, Node/Express, Tailwind, OpenAI (davinci & DALL·E), WebGL, React-Fiber, and Threejs to provide a responsive, immersive, and optimized experience for end-users
• Integrated Jest testing suite for proactive monitoring of internal API interaction with external API to facilitate a robust and predictable development environment

publications.title: A retrospective analysis of direct oral anticoagulants in dental management.
A phase 2, single-center, single-arm, open-label trial of vismodegib in patients with keratocystic odontogenic tumors.
